meta.title: DSH Commands (dsh-commands)
meta.description: Adds git-kit Git workflows, handoff session transfer, and disk-cleanup space reclamation to DSH as native slash commands (skills are provided by the ai-kit repo): commit message, commit and push, branch, PR/MR create and merge, tag, post-merge release (tag, platform Release, effect verification), repository slimming, star classification, a copy-paste resume prompt for a new session, and disk space cleanup that measures first and only removes what you select.
